judgement.reason: The outcome already requires changes, and the Dockerfile installing a release tarball with an unset build argument is a contained fix, since the repository contains the full application source.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported container setup: .docker/Dockerfile runs supervisord with a web server and a worker program (.docker/config/supervisord.conf) in one container. Deployz runs one web process and declared workers as separate services.
reviews.reason: The production image runs supervisord with php-fpm, nginx and a scheduler worker in one container, so the scheduler has to become a separate worker service.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares leantime_db (mysql:8.4) in .docker/docker-compose.yml; mariadb (a Helm dependency) in helm/Chart.yaml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared services are MySQL (mysql:8.4) and MariaDB, which is MySQL-compatible and enabled only by a Helm setting, so Deployz's managed MySQL can replace both.
